description: This file contains shell script functions for managing firmware upgrades on Mikrotik devices within the OpenWrt project, including functions to check image validity and perform device-specific upgrade procedures.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: A simple check function for the firmware image, always returns success.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_mikrotik_nand
methods.description: Performs a NAND upgrade specific to Mikrotik devices, extracting the kernel from the firmware package and flashing it.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade dispatcher that calls device-specific upgrade functions based on the device model.
